verified_picks.http_status: 200 LIVE (verified twice: page 200, and Workday CXS API /wday/cxs/ms/External/job/... returned 9,225 bytes of real payload). startDate 2026-09-21, timeType 'Full time', canApply=true, posted=true. No redirect, no 403.
verified_picks.reason: The screen scored the duration and ignored the function. The Required block (verified verbatim) reads '6 months to 2.5 years of experience in operations, finance support, program management, or a similar analyst role.' He clears the MONTHS and fails the FUNCTION — not one of his four internships is operations, finance support, or programme management (founder's office, data science, product management, ML dev). Second required line, 'Comfort working with financial data, expense processes, and system based tracking' — he has zero exposure to expense reports, accruals, accrual submissions or financial close, and the posting's own Example Deliverables are literally 'CX budget trackers and spend vs. plan summaries / Expense reports, accrual submissions, and reconciliation support'. Third, the degree line is in the REQUIRED block, not a soft miss as the screen claimed: 'Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Operations, or a related field' — B.Tech CSE is none of the four named and 'related field' is a recruiter's discretion, not his right. The why_fit is inverted advocacy: it opens with KOP AI mapped to Responsibility block D (AI/Automation), which is the LAST of four blocks and is scoped as 'lightweight automation/AI-assisted workflows... approved tools only; no sensitive data shared outside permitted environments' — i.e. sanctioned prompt libraries, not a 10-agent orchestration system. It sold the flattering 10% and buried the 90% (budget trackers, expense accruals, Salesforce hygiene, financial close deadlines) he has never touched. One point to the screen's credit, verified: Salesforce is NOT in Required — it appears in responsibilities and in Preferred only, so it is not a blocker. Finally it is a Full time immediate-start req posted 21 Sep 2026; declaring 'available June 2027' on it is a decline.

verified_picks.reason: Seniority is in the TITLE, not hidden: 'Associate/Analyst'. The highest posted experience requirement is the Associate track — 'A minimum of 3 years of experience in Data & Analytics (overall 3-5 years)'. Highest posted bar >> ~13 months, so by the stated rule this is 'no', not 'stretch'. The Analyst fallback is 'Experience of 2-2.5 years in data programming & SQL, preferably in the financial services industry' — his financial-services data programming is one 3-month CypherSOL internship; the screen laundered ~2 years of freelance web/app work into that line, which will not survive a recruiter reading the CV dates. Hard tool refutation the screen got wrong: it labelled Tableau a 'gap' but treated it as soft. I pulled the live body — the line 'Experience or knowledge in data analytics toolsets such as: SQL, Excel, Tableau, Python, Dataiku (nice to have)' sits under the header 'Required Skills:'. Tableau is in the required block and he does not have it; the '(nice to have)' qualifier attaches to Dataiku. The why_fit also overreaches on 'analyzing competitor flows' — at MS WM that means tracking advisor and asset movement between wirehouses off Cerulli-type industry flow data; a KJ Somaiya Spotify-India monetisation case win is not that, and saying so in an interview reads as padding. Full time, immediate, open since 11 Sep — gone well before June 2027.

verified_picks.reason: Grade is stated three times, not hidden: title 'Associate', body 'We're seeking an Associate to join our Internal Audit Data Risk team' and 'This is an Associate level position within the Business Audit'. The screen leaned its whole case on the phrase 'At least 2 years' relevant experience would generally be expected' being soft wording — that is Morgan Stanley's standard boilerplate across its Internal Audit reqs, not a concession, and 2 years still exceeds ~13 months. The screen then conceded in its own gaps field that he has 'zero audit experience and zero exposure to audit principles, tools and processes' — which is the FIRST and most binding required bullet — and scored it 54 anyway; that is internally inconsistent. The why_fit is the weakest of the four: it maps 'Develop clear and concise messages regarding risk and business impact' onto a 4th-of-400 case-comp deck at IIT Bombay. An IA screener reads that bullet as writing an audit issue against a specific control failure with a rated risk and an agreed management action. A consulting case deck is not audit issue-writing and the claim collapses in the first screen question. Credit where due and verified: the JD is only 7 qualification bullets and names no tool or credential he lacks (no CIA/CISA/ACAMS demanded) — but a short JD means the screen happens on grade and prior audit background, and he fails both. Full time, immediate start.

verified_picks.reason: Double seniority signal, and the screen read it backwards. Display title says 'Associate'; the URL slug says 'Infra-Capital-Markets--Senior-Analyst---Global-Capital-Market_JR038763-1'. The screen treated the slug as mildly helpful ('they have not filled it'). It is the opposite: the req is graded Senior Analyst/Associate, i.e. post-two-year, and the '-1' suffix marks it a RE-POST of a failed earlier run — a desk that failed to fill at that bar holds the bar, it does not drop to a student. Required-side tool and skill gaps, verified in the 'Skills and qualifications' block: 'Strong financial modelling ability and sound credit judgement' and 'familiarity with Bloomberg and market data tools (Bondradar, Dealogic, Pitchbook)'. He has never built a three-statement or project-finance model and has no terminal access. The experience line is '1-2 years of experience in investment banking, leveraged finance, project finance, infrastructure, energy, credit, structured finance' — he has zero months in any of them, below even the floor. The screen's single strongest hook, 'Programming and coding experience / knowledge of AI tools is encouraged', is the LAST bullet in the list and the verb is 'encouraged' — a tiebreaker between two bankers, not a door for a non-banker. And the Infiheal claim is the clearest flattery in the file: owning a Series A deck for your own startup is not 'pitch books, investment memoranda, credit approval materials, syndication materials, and internal committee presentations' for a tax-equity project financing. Separately, the screen's advice to spend 4-6 weeks building two models to chase this req is a bad trade — the req fills before the models ship, and MS GCM Mumbai staffs this seat from IB analysts, not from a GitHub repo.

honesty_check: LINK AUDIT: all four picks are genuinely live — no dead links, no 404s, and critically NO 403s, so nothing here is a bot-block I am dressing up as a pass. I verified each twice: the public page returned 200 with zero redirects, and the Workday content API (https://ms.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/wday/cxs/ms/External/job/<slug>) returned a full JSON payload for each with canApply=true, posted=true, real startDate and the complete jobDescription HTML. Every quotation in my reasons above is from that retrieved body, not from the screen file. All four are timeType 'Full time'. SEPARATE DEAD LINK FOUND: https://www.morganstanley.com/careers/students-graduates returns 404 (it serves a 93KB branded 404 page, which will look like a working page to anyone not checking the status code) — the live path is /people-opportunities/students-graduates (200). WHERE THE SCREEN FILE IS FACTUALLY WRONG: its company_verdict and may_2027_fit both assert that Morgan Stanley student programmes and 2027 intakes are 'NOT in this Workday feed'. That is false. I searched the same tenant and found 2027 cohort reqs sitting in it: 'Parametric - Investment Analyst Cohort, SUMMER 2027' (JR042790), 'Parametric Investment Analyst Winter Cohort 2027' (JR042797), 'Parametric - Operations Analyst Cohort, Winter/Summer 2027 (Recent Grads)' (JR043249/JR043248), '2027 Wealth Management Virtual Engagement Associate (VEA) Program' (JR042826) and 'Real Estate Investing, Pre-MBA Associate (2027 Program)' (JR028854). The tenant carries graduate programmes; they are simply all US-based. I then ran India-targeted searches on 'Intern', 'Internship India', 'Campus', 'Graduate' and '2027' — the only India hits were 'Return to Work Program' in Mumbai and Bengaluru, which are career-restart programmes for people re-entering after a break and are not open to him. So the screen's CONCLUSION (campus/graduate channel, not this feed) survives, but its stated reason did not, and the corrected fact matters: there is no live MS India campus or off-cycle-internship req anywhere today, which means the referral conversation, not a URL, is the actual asset this quarter. APPLY_URL CAVEAT: I tested https://www.morganstanley.com/careers/career-opportunities-search?opportunity=sg — 200, correct <title>Career Opportunities Search | Morgan Stanley</title>, real page referencing 'analyst programs'. But it is a client-side SPA: the served HTML is byte-identical with and without the ?opportunity=sg parameter (133,682 bytes both times), so the student filter is applied in-browser only and I could not confirm server-side what it lists for India. I am giving it as the best entry URL because it is the only tested-live door that can end in a hire for a May 2027 graduate — not because I watched it return an India role.
final_recommendation: All four picks are live links and all four are refuted as hires: three exceed his ~13 months on the highest posted bar (3-5 yrs Associate on PT-JR041535, 2 yrs on PT-JR043350, 1-2 yrs IB on JR038763), two put tools he lacks in the required block (Tableau under 'Required Skills:' on PT-JR041535; financial modelling and Bloomberg/Dealogic/Pitchbook on JR038763), and every one is a Full time immediate-start req that will close months before he is free in June 2027. File exactly ONE Workday application this week — PT-JR043560, the only req whose posted years band (6 months to 2.5 years) includes him — treating it purely as a way to create the MS candidate profile and put his name in front of a Mumbai WM recruiter, with an explicit availability line; skip the other three entirely, because a submission that auto-rejects on years spends the recruiter's attention for nothing. By 15 October do the two things that can actually produce an outcome: hit the DJSCE TPO to confirm whether Morgan Stanley is on the 2027-batch campus calendar and on what date, and message 15-20 DJSCE alumni in MS Mumbai with one question only — 'does your team take final-semester interns for January to May?' — targeting Analytics & Data / NNA Insights in Wealth Management and the E*TRADE CX team, since no India internship or campus req exists in the public feed today and that seat gets created in conversation or not at all. Set a standing weekly check on the students-and-graduates search for the India Analyst Programme opening, because MS India full-time analyst applications commonly close in the Oct-Dec window he is standing in right now. Spend learning time on advanced Excel plus Power Query and the Tableau Desktop Specialist cert so the CV that enters the 2027 programme screen already closes the two most-named tool gaps — and do not spend 4-6 weeks on project-finance models for JR038763, which is a re-posted Senior-Analyst-graded req he cannot win.
